correctness.rationale: Acyclic Forman matching exhaustively verified on all 331 faces, 160 pairs, 11 critical cells. Signed exact 5x5 Morse boundary all zero. With no one-cells, nullhomotopic degree-zero 3-cell attachments give actual integral wedge. S5 characters computed for all 120 elements using invariant boundary-image rank79, exact modular pivot inversion modulo 1009 and 1013, finite-order trace bound, chain trace identities; verified two char arrays, norms and quotient averages.

value.rationale: The object is the ordinary edge-matching complex of the canonical Petersen graph, whose full automorphism group is natural. Exact mixed integral wedge homotopy and the two inequivalent degree-wise 5D S5 modules together reveal information absent from Euler characteristic, Betti tables and matching enumerators. The contrast between rationally acyclic full quotient and degree-two alternating quotient is a mathematically interpretable symmetry consequence.
